BUILT 2026-08-05 (9346-97279 tablet / 9346-94331 mobile). The old note was half-stale: TokenProfileRow's "View full screen" CTA already opened a preview, but with the wrong chrome — an X top-right over a max-w-2xl box. Rebuilt to the frame's Overlay (9346:97575 / 9346:94590): "← Back" top-left (24px glyph + 10px gap + Manrope 18/22 at -4%; no-min-size so index.css's 44px rule cannot shift it off the frame's y-offset, with negative-margin padding keeping a 40px tap target), a Green Coal 300 wash instead of the primitive's black/80, and ONE centred square — 354px at 375 and 680px at 768, which is exactly what the frames' gutters (11px / 44px) and their perfectly-centred offsets resolve to, expressed as w-[min(100%,680px,calc(100dvh-88px))] so a landscape viewport clamps on height instead of overflowing. ★ RADIUS TRAP: the frame's "rounded-2xl" variable is 16px, which in this codebase is rounded-xl (ours 2xl is 24px). Real data throughout — the media is the user's own picked File via object URL, and object-contain is used over cover so a non-square upload is shown whole rather than cropped.
